objective: Build an HR policy agent using SharePoint policy documents.

harness.earlier_levels_insufficient_reason: Use existing M365 agent capability; configuration is needed to ground answers in the named SharePoint source.
harness.runtime_qualification_plan: Test grounded and unsupported prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot; static validation is not runtime qualification.
harness.rollback_restoration_plan: No cloud mutation until disposable target and restoration/cleanup approach are recorded.
harness.stop_conditions: Stop and reassess if WIQD prerequisites fail; evaluate Agents Toolkit before handoff.
harness.rationale: Declarative agent is the least-complex suitable M365 knowledge architecture; Standard Copilot Studio is not the universal default.
harness.dependency: Verify current WIQD/Agents Toolkit prerequisites, auth, and Development target during preflight.

knowledge.rationale: The objective names this source for searchable factual HR policy answers.
knowledge.dependency: Confirm authoritative site/library and access in Development preflight.

skills.rationale: No reusable multi-step procedure is requested.

tools_actions.rationale: The objective requests policy answers and names no live action or computation.

power_automate.rationale: No branching, approval, connector workflow, or asynchronous processing is stated.

dataverse_state.rationale: No structured application data or durable workflow state is required.

agents.rationale: The objective has one responsibility and no independent boundary.

external_integrations.rationale: This is the only named source; no additional integration is justified.
external_integrations.dependency: Exact source and access remain unverified.

custom_development.rationale: Native knowledge configuration is the lowest-complexity fit; no capability gap is identified.
